sorties.texte: Azul a Lyaznat, ma drus utulem. Taqeddact i d-yuɣalen seg ubrid-nni i d-yeɣlin s lexlawi. D
Tamurt n Leqbayel, d tin i d-yettekkan di tmenna n uxeddim, akken ad d-sbedden s usnulfu n litteɛ akken ad sbedden tawacult-
Aqcic-nni. Ad yawi akerwaṛ ɣef lḥiḍ-nni. Ad tezwiremt ɣer Tala Ḥemza. Ur nsedda ara ɣer Ceṛfa. D ameddakel-
Deg uzekka-nni, i wakken ad t-id-rnuɣ, ad tt-rreɣ i wawras ɣef tdeblin n tdeblin, yerna ad ssuffɣeɣ as
Tameṭṭut-nni tenna-yas i ɛeggu: Acimi akka ara k-id-tesseɣliv akka? Ixef wis kraḍ Tasleḍt n wammud DALLLET N Tiɣbu
Asmi i yesteɛfa wul-is, yerna-as-d ad yerzu ɣer tmurt, imi yesḥulfeyaf-as. Ur tezribem ara ihi ɣer Tiz
